assignmentTitle: Construction and Design Verification of a Leaf Spring

criteria.title: Observe the Leaf Spring Suspension
criteria.description: Understanding client brief, commercial vehicle rear axle leaf spring application, and project scope.

criteria.title: Identify Leaf Spring Components
criteria.description: Accurate labeling of master leaf, graduated leaves, front spring eye, rear eye & shackle, centre bolt, U-bolts, axle seat, and rear axle on EA-13.

criteria.title: Understand Leaf Spring Construction
criteria.description: Understanding multi-leaf construction, master vs graduated leaves, uniform bending strength principle, and rebound clips.

criteria.title: Understand the Load Path
criteria.description: Tracing the load transmission path from vehicle chassis to leaf spring eyes, axle seat, and road wheels.

criteria.title: Establish the Engineering Model
criteria.description: Converting axle load (40 kN) to spring central load (20 kN), eye end reaction (10 kN), and semi-span length (500 mm).

criteria.title: Establish Design Requirements
criteria.description: Identifying leaf parameters: n = 10 total leaves, leaf width b = 60 mm, leaf thickness t = 8 mm, and material yield strength Syt = 900 N/mm².

criteria.title: Verify Bending Stress
criteria.description: Calculating maximum bending moment (M_max = 5000 kN.mm), total section modulus (Z = 6400 mm³), and max bending stress (sigma_b = 781.25 N/mm²).

criteria.title: Verify Deflection and Factor of Safety
criteria.description: Determining spring deflection (delta = 117.94 mm) and actual Factor of Safety (FoS = 1.15).

criteria.title: Engineering Judgement
criteria.description: Evaluating spring suitability under static payload and dynamic shock overload, proposing leaf count or thickness adjustments.

criteria.title: Engineering Verification Report
criteria.description: Synthesizing concise engineering verification report covering leaf spring construction, stress checks, FoS, and maintenance specs.
